sentence: This project builds a sensing and control system that helps power distribution systems keep working during extreme weather and cyber-attacks.
This project builds artificial intelligence models that run faster and more accurately for physical simulations of materials and plasma.
This project builds statistical tools that combine several data sources so that conclusions drawn from survey data are more reliable.
This project studies how small RNA molecules made by a host act against bacteria that cause infection in oral and respiratory systems.
This project builds shared ways for researchers in hydrology, oceans and seismology to make their data open and easy to reuse.
This project studies how tiny building blocks that do not fit together perfectly join up into structures that stop growing at a set size.
This project uses quantum physics theory to study how low-dimensional electronic materials interact with light and how their surroundings affect them.
This project studies coral reefs and rainforests on an island and tests whether newer data collection methods work as well as traditional surveys.
This project studies how bacteria in soil clumps talk to and cooperate with each other, and how this affects the cycling of carbon, nitrogen and phosphorus.
This project builds biological systems to solve problems, such as sensors for contaminants in water, self-healing materials and designed enzymes.
This project studies why some fruit flies survive and reproduce better than others by linking differences in their genes to survival and mating success.
This project studies qubits and builds quantum algorithms and tools for quantum networking, communication and sensing.
This project studies how pore size and stiffness of a material affect which immune cells, such as T cells, move into it.
This project studies finfish and shellfish to improve how fisheries are managed, using biological data on fish stocks.
This project builds a microscope that uses a laser-levitated probe to measure surfaces without touching them.
This project builds computer methods to predict how soft polymer materials swell and change shape under mechanical, chemical and electrical forces.
